Opaque pagination cursor. Take this value from the previous response's `links[]` entry whose `name`
is `"next"` (typically just follow that link's `href` instead of reading this value).
Omit on the first page. If the previous response had no `next` link, there are no more pages.

items.docs:
Returns a list of workflow run assignees for the given workflow run.
The results are returned 20 at a time.
You must use the links section to get the next 20 results.

params.name: workflowId
params.description: The ID of the Workflow (can be copied from the Workflow URL in the web app)

params.name: name
params.description: The partial name of the Workflow Run to search for (will match any part of the name in a case-insensitive manner)

params.name: status
params.description:
The status (or statuses) to filter by (Active, Completed or Archived).
If no status is provided, it will default to Active.
Multiple statuses can be provided as a comma-separated list.

params.name: fields
params.description:
The partial values of form field values to search for. It will match any part of the value in a case-insensitive manner. If there are multiple form field values, then Workflow Runs that match any of them will be returned.

Example (before being URL-encoded): ?fields[lD7FTF9R63xNCLn8w_xMdw]=value_1&fields[lD7FTF9R63xNCLn8w_xMab]=value_2

items.docs: Returns the latest 200 workflow runs of a workflow, showing the most recently updated first.

params.description: Filter results to runs of a specific workflow. If the workflow does not exist or is inaccessible, the response is an empty page rather than an error.

params.name: status
params.description:
Filter results by workflow run status.

- `Active` — the run is in progress.
- `Completed` — all tasks were completed and the run was finalised.
- `Archived` — the run was archived from the active list.

The internal `Deleted` status is hidden from the public API surface and rejected here.
Omit this filter to include all non-deleted runs.
